species.name: Cubone
species.entry: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

species.name: Marowak

species.name: Hitmonlee
species.entry: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

species.name: Hitmonchan
species.entry: A Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.

species.name: Lickitung
species.entry: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

evo.text: Level it up while it knows Rollout.

species.name: Koffing
species.entry: Getting up close to a Koffing will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 35 during the day.
It evolves when it reaches level 35 at night.

species.name: Weezing
species.entry: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

species.name: Galarian Weezing
species.entry: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.

species.name: Rhyhorn
species.entry: Once it starts running, it doesn't stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can't remember why it started running in the first place.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 42.

species.name: Rhydon
species.entry: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.

evo.text: Trade it while it holds a Protector.

species.name: Chansey
species.entry: Chansey lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

evo.text: Level it up while it is very friendly toward you.

species.name: Tangela
species.entry: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.

evo.text: Level it up while it knows Ancient Power.

species.name: Kangaskhan
species.entry: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

species.name: Mega Kangaskhan
species.entry: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.

species.name: Horsea

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 32.

species.name: Seadra
species.entry: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.

evo.text: Trade it while it holds a Dragon Scale.

species.name: Goldeen
species.entry: In the springtime, schools of Goldeen can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 33.

species.name: Seaking
species.entry: It punches holes in boulders on stream- beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.

species.name: Staryu
species.entry: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.

evo.text: Use a Water Stone on it.

species.name: Starmie
species.entry: People in ancient times imagined that Starmie were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.

species.name: Mr. Mime

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 42.

species.name: Scyther
species.entry: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.

evo.text: Trade it while it holds a Metal Coat.
Trade it while it holds a Black Augurite.

species.name: Jynx
species.entry: A Jynx sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.

species.name: Electabuzz
species.entry: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.

evo.text: Trade it while it holds an Electirizer.

species.name: Magmar
species.entry: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.

evo.text: Trade it while it holds a Magmarizer.

species.name: Pinsir

species.name: Mega Pinsir
species.entry: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, Pinsir burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.

species.name: Tauros
species.entry: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.

species.name: Magikarp
species.entry: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many Magikarp deposited there by the flow.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.

species.name: Gyarados

species.entry: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

species.entry: The fragrance of a Meganium's flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe's fighting spirit.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 14.

species.entry: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.

species.entry: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 15.

species.name: Furret
species.entry: A Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.

species.name: Hoothoot

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.

species.entry: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. Noctowl owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 18.

species.entry: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many Ledian. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 22.

species.name: Ariados
species.entry: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.

species.entry: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 27.

evo.text: Level it up while it is very friendly toward you.

species.name: Cleffa
species.entry: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

evo.text: Level it up while it is very friendly toward you.

species.name: Igglybuff
species.entry: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.

evo.text: Level it up while it is very friendly toward you.

evo.text: Level it up while it is very friendly toward you.

species.name: Togetic
species.entry: It is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a Togetic appears and shares its happiness with that person.

evo.text: Use a Shiny Stone on it.

species.name: Natu
species.entry: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A Natu's eyes look as if they are always observing something.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 25.

species.name: Xatu
species.entry: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that Xatu are emissaries from another world.

species.name: Mareep
species.entry: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 15.

species.name: Flaaffy

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Ampharos

species.name: Marill

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 18.

species.name: Azumarill
species.entry: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.

species.name: Sudowoodo
species.entry: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

species.name: Politoed
species.entry: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.

species.name: Hoppip
species.entry: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a Hoppip links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 18.

species.name: Skiploom
species.entry: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 27.

species.name: Jumpluff
species.entry: Jumpluff ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This Pokémon lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

species.name: Aipom

evo.text: Level it up while it knows Double Hit.

species.name: Sunkern
species.entry: Sunkern try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

species.name: Sunflora
species.entry: Sunflora convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.

species.name: Yanma
species.entry: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.

evo.text: Level it up while it knows Ancient Power.

species.name: Wooper
species.entry: Wooper usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.

species.name: Quagsire
species.entry: A Quagsire hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.

species.name: Espeon
species.entry: An Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.

species.name: Umbreon
species.entry: Umbreon evolved from exposure to the moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

species.name: Murkrow

evo.text: Use a Dusk Stone on it.

evo.text: Use a Dusk Stone on it.

species.name: Unown
species.entry: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown.

species.name: Gligar

evo.text: Level it up at night while it holds a Razor Fang.

species.name: Mega Scizor
species.entry: A Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

species.name: Shuckle
species.entry: A Shuckle hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

species.name: Heracross
species.entry: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

species.name: Mega Heracross
species.entry: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

species.name: Sneasel
species.entry: A Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.

evo.text: Level it up at night while it holds a Razor Claw.

species.name: Teddiursa
species.entry: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A Teddiursa makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Ursaring
species.entry: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an Ursaring gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.

evo.text: Level it up at night while it holds a Peat Block.

species.name: Slugma
species.entry: It is a species of Pokémon that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 38.

species.name: Magcargo
species.entry: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned Magcargo's bodies into magma.

species.name: Swinub
species.entry: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 33.

species.name: Piloswine
species.entry: A Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.

evo.text: Level it up while it knows Ancient Power.

species.name: Corsola
species.entry: Corsola live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

species.name: Galarian Corsola
species.entry: Corsola live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 38.

species.name: Remoraid
species.entry: A Remoraid uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 25.

species.name: Octillery
species.entry: It ensnares its foe with its suction- cupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.

species.name: Delibird
species.entry: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a Delibird sharing its food.

species.name: Mantine
species.entry: On sunny days, schools of Mantine can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the Remoraid that hitches rides.

species.name: Skarmory
species.entry: A Pokémon that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from Skarmory to make swords and knives.

species.name: Houndour
species.entry: Houndour communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This Pokémon's remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 24.

species.name: Houndoom
species.entry: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

species.name: Mega Houndoom
species.entry: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.

species.name: Kingdra
species.entry: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.

species.name: Phanpy
species.entry: Phanpy's big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 25.

species.name: Donphan
species.entry: A Donphan is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.

species.name: Porygon2
species.entry: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

evo.text: Trade it while it holds a Dubious Disc.

species.name: Stantler
species.entry: Stantler's magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction.

evo.text: Let it hold a Hisuian Pill when it reaches the level it would normally evolve at.

species.name: Smeargle
species.entry: A Smeargle marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.

species.name: Tyrogue
species.entry: Tyrogue become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the Trainer must establish a regular training schedule.

evo.text: It evolves at level 20 when its Attack is lower than its Defense.
It evolves at level 20 when its Attack is higher than its Defense.
It evolves at level 20 when its Attack is equal to its Defense.

species.name: Hitmontop
species.entry: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. Hitmontop travel faster spinning than they do walking.

species.name: Smoochum
species.entry: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Elekid
species.entry: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an Elekid begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Magby
species.entry: If a Magby is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Miltank
species.entry: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

species.name: Blissey
species.entry: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a Blissey will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.

species.name: Raikou
species.entry: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.

species.name: Entei
species.entry: Entei embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.

species.name: Suicune
species.entry: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.

species.name: Larvitar
species.entry: A Larvitar is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Pupitar
species.entry: A Pupitar creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 55.

species.name: Tyranitar
species.entry: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

species.name: Mega Tyranitar
species.entry: A Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

species.name: Lugia
species.entry: Lugia is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

species.name: Shadow Lugia
species.entry: Lugia is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

species.name: Ho-oh
species.entry: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

species.name: Celebi
species.entry: This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.

species.name: Treecko
species.entry: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 16.

species.name: Grovyle
species.entry: Leaves grow out of this Pokémon's body. They help obscure a Grovyle from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 36.

species.name: Sceptile
species.entry: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

species.name: Mega Sceptile
species.entry: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

species.name: Torchic
species.entry: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A Torchic dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 16.

species.name: Combusken
species.entry: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 36.

species.name: Blaziken
species.entry: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

species.name: Mega Blaziken
species.entry: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

species.name: Mudkip
species.entry: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 16.

species.name: Marshtomp
species.entry: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 36.

species.name: Swampert
species.entry: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

species.name: Mega Swampert
species.entry: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

species.name: Poochyena
species.entry: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 18.

species.name: Mightyena
species.entry: In the wild, Mightyena live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

species.name: Zigzagoon
species.entry: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.

species.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
species.entry: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.

species.name: Linoone
species.entry: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

species.name: Galarian Linoone
species.entry: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots pond- dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 35 at night.

species.name: Wurmple
species.entry: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.

evo.text: It evolves at level 7. Which form it takes depends on the Pokémon itself.
It evolves at level 7. Which form it takes depends on the Pokémon itself.

species.name: Silcoon
species.entry: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a Wurmple. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 10.

species.name: Beautifly
species.entry: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.

species.name: Cascoon
species.entry: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 10.

species.name: Dustox
species.entry: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.

species.name: Lotad
species.entry: This Pokémon lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small Pokémon across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 14.

species.name: Lombre
species.entry: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.

evo.text: Use a Water Stone on it.

species.name: Ludicolo
species.entry: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

species.name: Seedot
species.entry: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 14.

species.name: Nuzleaf
species.entry: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.

evo.text: Use a Leaf Stone on it.

species.name: Shiftry
species.entry: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this Pokémon lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.

species.name: Taillow
species.entry: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger Skarmory on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 22.

species.name: Swellow
species.entry: A Swellow dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.

species.name: Wingull
species.entry: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 25.

species.name: Pelipper
species.entry: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

species.name: Ralts
species.entry: A Ralts has the power to sense the emotions of people and Pokémon with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.

species.name: Kirlia
species.entry: A Kirlia has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.
Use a Dawn Stone on a male one.

species.name: Gardevoir
species.entry: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

species.name: Mega Gardevoir
species.entry: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its Trainer.

species.name: Surskit
species.entry: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 22.

species.name: Masquerain
species.entry: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.

species.name: Shroomish
species.entry: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many Shroomish feasting on composted soil.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 23.

species.name: Breloom
species.entry: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.

species.name: Slakoth
species.entry: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 18.

species.name: Vigoroth
species.entry: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 36.

species.name: Slaking
species.entry: Hordes of Slaking gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.

species.name: Nincada
species.entry: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.
It appears when Nincada evolves at level 20, if the party has a free space and there is a Poké Ball in the Bag.

species.name: Ninjask
species.entry: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.

species.name: Shedinja
species.entry: A peculiar Pokémon that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.

species.name: Whismur
species.entry: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 20.

species.name: Loudred
species.entry: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 40.

species.name: Exploud
species.entry: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

species.name: Makuhita
species.entry: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of Makuhita undertaking strenuous training.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 24.

species.name: Hariyama
species.entry: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

species.name: Azurill
species.entry: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.

evo.text: Level it up while it is very friendly toward you. To get its Egg, a parent must hold a Sea Incense.

species.name: Nosepass
species.entry: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.

evo.text: Level it up at New Mauville.

species.name: Skitty
species.entry: A Skitty's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.

evo.text: Use a Moon Stone on it.

species.name: Delcatty
species.entry: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.

species.name: Sableye
species.entry: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

species.name: Mega Sableye
species.entry: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A Sableye lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.

species.name: Mawile
species.entry: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Mega Mawile
species.entry: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.

species.name: Aron
species.entry: A Pokémon that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 32.

species.name: Lairon
species.entry: When two Lairon meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 42.

species.name: Aggron
species.entry: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

species.name: Mega Aggron
species.entry: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

species.name: Meditite
species.entry: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 37.

species.name: Medicham
species.entry: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

species.name: Mega Medicham
species.entry: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

species.name: Electrike
species.entry: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 26.

species.name: Manectric
species.entry: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

species.name: Mega Manectric
species.entry: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, Manectric were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

species.name: Plusle
species.entry: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow Pokémon. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.

species.name: Minun
species.entry: At a meeting of Pokémon academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a Plusle and Minun will promote circulation and boost vitality.

species.name: Volbeat
species.entry: With their taillights lit, Volbeat fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.

species.name: Illumise
species.entry: A nocturnal Pokémon that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a Volbeat swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.

species.name: Roselia
species.entry: A Roselia that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.

evo.text: Use a Shiny Stone on it.

species.name: Gulpin
species.entry: This Pokémon's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 26.

species.name: Swalot
species.entry: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a Swalot can't digest is its own stomach.

species.name: Carvanha
species.entry: Carvanha attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious Pokémon, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Sharpedo
species.entry: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

species.name: Mega Sharpedo
species.entry: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.

species.name: Wailmer
species.entry: While this Pokémon usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 40.

species.name: Wailord
species.entry: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a Wailord can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

species.name: Numel
species.entry: A Numel stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy Pokémon that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 33.

species.name: Camerupt
species.entry: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

species.name: Mega Camerupt
species.entry: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

species.name: Torkoal
species.entry: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.

species.name: Spoink
species.entry: A Pokémon that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 32.

species.name: Grumpig
species.entry: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

species.name: Spinda
species.entry: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.

species.name: Trapinch
species.entry: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 35.

species.name: Vibrava
species.entry: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a Vibrava's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 45.

species.name: Flygon
species.entry: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Flygon (alt. form)
species.entry: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.

species.name: Cacnea
species.entry: Cacnea live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 32.

species.name: Cacturne
species.entry: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

species.name: Swablu
species.entry: A Pokémon that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, Swablu flocks move closer to towns in the spring.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 35.

species.name: Altaria
species.entry: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

species.name: Mega Altaria
species.entry: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

species.name: Zangoose
species.entry: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any Seviper.

species.name: Seviper
species.entry: Seviper and Zangoose are eternal rivals. It counters a Zangoose's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.

species.name: Lunatone
species.entry: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This Pokémon was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.

species.name: Solrock
species.entry: Solar energy is the source of this Pokémon's power. On sunny days, groups of Solrock line up facing the sun and absorb its light.

species.name: Barboach
species.entry: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the Barboach's body.

evo.text: It evolves when it reaches level 30.

species.name: Whiscash

species.name: Feebas
species.entry: Feebas live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. Because of its hopelessly shabby appearance, it seems as if few Trainers raise it.

species.name: Milotic
species.entry: It is said to live at the bottom of large lakes. Considered to be the most beautiful of all Pokémon, it has been depicted in paintings and statues.

species.name: Castform
